arguments.message: Hi there! If the project was deleted within the last 30 days, it’s still recoverable. An admin can go to **Settings → Data → Deleted items** and restore it, which brings back all records, configuration, and automation exactly as they were. After the 30‑day window the deletion becomes permanent and we can’t recover it. Let me know if you need any help with the restore process!
